title: Pokémon Timeline — the complete history in 3D
description: Fly through Pokémon history from Red and Green in 1996 to today: every main-series game, remake and DLC, every anime season and film, TCG eras, key spin-offs and milestones, with Japanese and Western release dates.
blurb: From Red and Green in 1996 to today: the main-series games, the anime, the films, the card game, key spin-offs and the milestones in between, with Japanese and Western release dates kept apart.
toHistory: This is the real-world timeline of the games, anime and films. For the history inside the Pokémon world, see The History of the Pokémon World.
eventFly: Fly to it on the 3D Pokémon Timeline.
